courses.title: STATISTICAL CONCEPTS
courses.antireqText: Main campus: Biology 2244A/B, Data Science 1000A/B, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2037A/B. Antirequisite(s) at King's campus: Data Science 1000A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Biology 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2037A/B.

courses.title: INTRODUCTION TO STATISTICS
courses.prereqText: Grade 12U Mathematics or Mathematics 0109A/B, Mathematics 0110A/B or Mathematics 1229A/B.
courses.antireqText: All other courses or half courses in Introductory Statistics, except Statistical Sciences 1023A/B and Statistical Sciences 2037A/B, Data Science 1000A/B.

courses.title: STATISTICS FOR BUSINESS AND SOCIAL SCIENCES
courses.prereqText: One full course or equivalent from: Applied Mathematics 1201A/B, Data Science 1000A/B, (Calculus 1000A/B or Calculus 1500A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B), (Calculus 1301A/B or Calculus 1501A/B or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B or the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B), Mathematics 1600A/B or Mathematics 1700A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Mathematics 1228A/B, Mathematics 1229A/B, Mathematics 1230A/B, or the former Applied Mathematics 1413, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B.
courses.antireqText: Main Campus: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Statistical Sciences 1023A/B and Data Science 1000A/B or the former Statistical Sciences 1024A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B or the former Psychology 2810, Psychology 2801F/G or the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, the former Social Work 2207A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2858A/B. Antirequisite(s) at King's: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Statistical Sciences 1023A/B and Statistical Sciences 1024A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B, the former Psychology 2810, the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, the former Social Work 2207A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2858A/B.

courses.title: STATISTICS FOR HEALTH
courses.antireqText: Main campus: Biology 2244A/B, Data Science 1000A/B, Statistical Sciences 1023A/B, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B. Antirequisite(s) at Huron: All other courses or half courses in Introductory Statistics.

courses.title: APPLIED PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS FOR ENGINEERS
courses.prereqText: 0.5 course from Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B, plus 0.5 course from Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B. The former Applied Mathematics 1413 may also be used to meet this 1.0 course prerequisite.
courses.antireqText: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Data Science 1000A/B, Statistical Sciences 1023A/B or Statistical Sciences 1024A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B or the former Psychology 2810, Psychology 2801F/G or the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2858A/B, the former Social Work 2207A/B.

courses.title: APPLIED STATISTICS AND DATA ANALYSIS FOR ENGINEERS
courses.prereqText: 0.5 course from Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B, Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B, plus 0.5 course from Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B, Calculus 1301A/B, Calculus 1501A/B, the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B. The former Applied Mathematics 1413 may also be used to meet this 1.0 course prerequisite.
courses.antireqText: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Statistical Sciences 1023A/B, Data Science 1000A/B or Statistical Sciences 1024A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B,MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B or the former Psychology 2810, Psychology 2801F/G or the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, Social Work 2207A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, Statistical Sciences 2858A/B.

courses.title: STATISTICS FOR SCIENCE
courses.prereqText: 1.0 Mathematics course or equivalent numbered 1000 or above. Data Science 1000A/B or Integrated Science 1001X or Statistical Sciences 1024A/B can be used to meet 0.5 of the 1.0 mathematics course requirement.
courses.antireqText: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Data Science 1000A/B, Statistical Sciences 1023A/B, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B, Statistical Sciences 2037A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B or the former Psychology 2810, Psychology 2801F/G or the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2858A/B, the former Social Work 2207A/B.

courses.title: ADVANCED MATHEMATICS FOR STATISTICAL APPLICATIONS
courses.prereqText: Calculus 2402A/B or (the former Calculus 2502A/B and the former Calculus 2503A/B) or (the former Calculus 2502A/B and the former Mathematics 2123A/B), Mathematics 1600A/B or Mathematics 1700A/B (or the former Linear Algebra 1600A/B) or Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1411A/B (or the former Applied Mathematics 1411A/B), Statistical Sciences 2857A/B or Economics 2122A/B. In each course a minimum mark of 60% is required.

courses.title: PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS I
courses.prereqText: 0.5 course from Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B (or the former Applied Mathematics 1412A/B), each with a minimum mark of 60%, plus 0.5 course from Calculus 1301A/B (minimum mark 85%), Calculus 1501A/B (minimum mark 60%), Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1414A/B (or the former Applied Mathematics 1414A/B) (minimum mark 60%). The former Applied Mathematics 1413 with a minimum mark of 60% may also be used to meet this 1.0 course prerequisite.

courses.title: PROBABILITY AND STATISTICS II
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2857A/B.
courses.antireqText: All other courses in Introductory Statistics (except Statistical Sciences 1023A/B and Data Science 1000A/B or the former Statistical Sciences 1024A/B): Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2122A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Health Sciences 3801A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2811A/B or the former Psychology 2810, Psychology 2801F/G or the former Psychology 2820E, Psychology 2830A/B, Psychology 2850A/B, Psychology 2851A/B, Social Work 2207A/B, Sociology 2205A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B.

courses.title: STATISTICAL PROGRAMMING
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2857A/B or a minimum mark of 70% in one of Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2222A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2812A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, or the former Psychology 2810.

courses.title: INTERMEDIATE PROBABILITY
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2858A/B and in Statistical Sciences 2503A/B or Calculus 2503A/B.

courses.title: INTRODUCTION TO STUDY DESIGN
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2858A/B or a minimum mark of 70% in one of Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2222A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2812A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B or the former Psychology 2810.

courses.title: MATHEMATICAL STATISTICS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B.

courses.title: REGRESSION
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2858A/B.

courses.title: GENERALIZED LINEAR MODELS
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 3859A/B with at least 60%.

courses.title: APPLIED LINEAR MODELS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 2858A/B or a minimum mark of 70% in one of Biology 2244A/B, Economics 2222A/B, MOS 2242A/B, Psychology 2812A/B, Statistical Sciences 2035, Statistical Sciences 2141A/B, Statistical Sciences 2143A/B, Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, or the former Psychology 2810. Enrollment in a module offered by either the Department of Statistical and Actuarial Sciences or Mathematics.

courses.title: MARKOV CHAINS WITH APPLICATIONS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B.
courses.antireqText: The former Statistical Sciences 3652A/B, former Statistical Sciences 4652A/B, former Statistical Sciences 4657A/B and former Statistical Sciences 4737A/B.

courses.title: DATA ANALYTICS CONSULTING
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 3859A/B with at least 60%. Registration in fourth year of the Honours Specialization in Data Science or Honours Specialization in Statistics modules.

courses.title: EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 3843A/B or Statistical Sciences 2858A/B and Statistical Sciences 3859A/B.

courses.title: ADVANCED DATA ANALYSIS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in both Statistical Sciences 3843A/B and Statistical Sciences 3859A/B.

courses.title: SAMPLING THEORY AND METHODS
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 3859A/B or Statistical Sciences 3843A/B.

courses.title: ADVANCED REGRESSION
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 3859A/B.

courses.title: TIME SERIES
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in both Statistical Sciences 3858A/B and Statistical Sciences 2864A/B.

courses.title: ADVANCED STATISTICAL COMPUTING
courses.prereqText: Statistical Sciences 2864A/B and Statistical Sciences 3859A/B.

courses.title: SELECTED TOPICS IN STATISTICS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B or permission of the department.

courses.title: SELECTED TOPICS IN STATISTICS
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 60% in Statistical Sciences 3657A/B and permission of the department.

courses.title: BUSINESS SKILLS FOR FINANCIAL PROFESSIONALS, DATA SCIENTISTS AND OTHER QUANTITATIVE PROFESSIONALS
courses.prereqText: Registration in fourth year of an Actuarial Science, Data Science, Statistics or Financial Modeling module.

courses.title: PROJECT IN STATISTICAL SCIENCES
courses.prereqText: Registration in the fourth year of the Honours Specialization in Actuarial Science, Statistics, or Financial Modelling. Students must have a modular course average of at least 80% and must find a faculty member to supervise the project.
courses.antireqText: Data Science 4999Z, Actuarial Science 4997F/G/Z, Financial Modelling 4998F/G/Z.
